note: Floors the check uses when no flag is given. They are first settings chosen for mstack, written from memory of common practice and not read in a primary source during this work. Set your own with the flags of agree.py.

min_examples.source: mstack default, first setting; below this the agreement figure moves several points with every single example

min_per_label.source: mstack default, first setting; a grader cannot be judged on a label it has hardly seen

min_agreement.unit: share of examples where grader and human give the same label (0 to 1)
min_agreement.source: mstack default, first setting; agree the floor with the owner of the evaluation

min_kappa.source: a common rule of thumb for 'substantial' agreement, written from memory; the original paper was not opened
